text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — prepping a Strategic Health Brief for AcmeCorp EBR next Tue 9am PT. Draft deck attached. Need an exec-ready 1-pager + clear renewal risk slide. Please confirm owners below by EOD Fri. cc @Priya Nair @Luis Gomez :eyes:

Luis Gomez: On it. I'll update the renewal-risk slide with the latest usage trend and contract timeline.

Priya Nair: I'll take the exec 1-pager and ROI bullets. Can someone grab the latest NPS snapshot?

Zoe Patel: I'll validate demo clips and backup screenshots. Where's the deck link?

Maya Chen: Deck is here: https://redwood.co/s/drive/abc123 (internal). Current slide owners block below — please confirm or edit inline:

```
1 - Maya Chen (strategic overview + agenda)
2 - Priya Nair (exec 1-pager / asks)
3 - Luis Gomez (usage trends & renewal risk)
4 - Zoe Patel (demo assets / screenshots)
5 - Dan O'Leary (technical appendix / infra notes)
6 - Samira Khan (action items tracker)
```

Dan O'Leary: I'll add latency + infra notes. Quick Q: do we want to surface the dedicated-capacity bump ask now or hold until exec Q&A?

Priya Nair: Add it as a clear ask on slide 2 with the cost delta and business reason. Better to be explicit.

Samira Khan: I'll compile the action-item tracker and owner SLAs after folks confirm. Will post tracker link by EOD Thu.

ebr-bot: Reminder: EBR prep deadline set to 2025-05-02 17:00 UTC. Please make sure slide changes are in the shared deck before that.

Maya Chen: :thumbsup: Last ask — any short customer quote we can surface on slide 1? @Priya @Zoe

Priya Nair: I have a short line from Acme's VP Product: "Redwood made inference predictable for our expansion." Happy to include.

Zoe Patel: Nice. I'll drop it into slide 1 and render updated screenshots.

Luis Gomez: Flagging renewal timing: mid-June. Recommend a targeted canary offer to the economic buyer to reduce churn risk — added to slide 3.

Maya Chen: Great. Action summary: Priya finalize slide 2 (exec ask + ROI), Luis update slide 3 (usage + renewal), Zoe prepare demo assets, Dan add infra appendix, Samira publish action tracker. Deadline: EOD Fri for slide updates; dry run Mon 9am PT. Thanks team. :rocket:
